input.quote: 12.3 Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie. AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 gives us (AbbVie, the customer/licensee) a unilateral termination-for-convenience right, in whole or on a country-by-country basis, "for any or no reason" on ninety (90) days' written notice, with no early-termination fee or other penalty anywhere in the agreement (no termination fee provision exists; Section 12.10.2 only preserves sell-off rights). Harpoon has no convenience right at all — its termination rights are limited to material breach (Sections 12.2.1/12.2.2) and insolvency (Section 12.4). This sits at the playbook fallback (customer termination on 60–90 days' notice, no fee, no vendor convenience right) and in fact exceeds the fallback on the vendor side, so no redline. Noted only as minor sub-elements short of the preferred position: notice is 90 days rather than 30, and there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts — the latter is of limited relevance in a milestone/royalty-based development and option structure.
